findings.evidence: Confluence page 2129922 «Требования тест 4» (version 1, space ~712020235d49aa26bb4f3e8f425cb4c132578a) retrieved with an empty body: `content: ""`. The page is accessible (read access confirmed) and authenticated, but contains no requirements, no REQ-IDs, no boundaries, no exceptions, no dependencies, no acceptance criteria, no NFRs and no Non-Goals.
findings.impact: The document has no requirements at all, so nothing can be reviewed for contradictions or ambiguities and no design/test design can be derived. There is no single requirement from which a deterministic Given/When/Then acceptance criterion could be built.
findings.recommendation: Populate the Confluence page with the actual requirements — scope/boundaries, numbered REQ-IDs, acceptance criteria, Non-Goals, NFRs, dependencies and exceptions — then re-run the requirement review.
